title: Every member-facing "What's On" reads "What's happening", and the Circle tab reads "What's Happening"

source.ref: ADR-1738. Owner 2026-10-13: change all the naming now in the docs, from the Frequency design system handoff of the same day (What's on → What's happening in all nav, menus, labels and copy).

detail:
The canon moved in ADR-1738 (docs/NAMING.md, the core belief section); the code did not. Nine member-facing strings still say the old label: the Circle tab (lib/circles/tabs.ts) and its page title (app/(main)/circles/[slug]/(circle)/whats-on/page.tsx), the Nearby quick link, the public Space sign-in prompt, the events error state, two lines on the feed's community board, and two lines of the welcome email (lib/email.ts). Sentence case in copy and menus, title case for the Circle tab. The /whats-on route stays (route ≠ label, ADR-1023). "What's on your mind?" is the composer prompt and stays (NAMING.md collision guard). Re-measure with the probe before porting: other sessions land copy on main.

Shipped 2026-10-13: the Circle tab and its page title read What's Happening; the Nearby link, the public Space prompt, the events error state, the feed's community board and the welcome email read what's happening. /whats-on stays.
